bullets.text: Copilot Enhancements Roll Out - **Microsoft** introduces real-time text editing features for **Windows Insiders** via Copilot.
Microsoft Store Growth - Over 250 million users enjoyed a more personalized **Microsoft Store** experience in 2025.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and improvements are rolling out in **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build 26220.7523.
AI-Driven Clipboard Management - **PowerToys** introduces an advanced clipboard management tool with AI capabilities.
Unified Security Approach - **Microsoft** advocates for a unified, AI-ready security platform to combat cyberthreats effectively.
Generative AI Defense Leader - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in **KuppingerCole** Leadership Compass for Generative AI Defense.
